note: PIN-1 (PROTOCOL_NOTES §15): every firmware fact in code cites file:line at one of these commits. Re-pin, re-check every citation and review the diff at each firmware bump (CODEOWNERS: owner).

EN.note: Re-pinned 2026-11-12 from a7489b79 (450.02) to ee98f02b, the 450.04 pre-release tag, with owner approval. E060 adds spph (default 1), spde and coph: Run requires spph=0 before control and never writes spde/coph. N93 defers startup input processing; status 157 refuses centre-format arcs with missing offsets without an alarm. fs v2 adds a seventh cause and rt job/fg; RTS hosts must keep unanswered input within 192 bytes. Limit handling during arcs, output commands and dwells is corrected; kill/flush ends built-in programs; 440 settings migrate; PWM settings retain decimals. N99 is absent: a standalone dwell reports the prior state with a free planner slot, so the host dwell guard remains. Later builds sharing fb 450.04 may include N99; fb cannot distinguish them. Only the unsigned staging bench manifest is extended here; signing remains with the owner. No image has passed D5 and classification never relies on fb alone (PN §2.3). D4 is done; fbs/cap identity tokens and D5 image approval remain separate.
